caption: First week check done, and a roof with a cold floor. I read the comments at night, and the place I actually answer is on my profile.

First week check done. A note on my timing in the second chorus, and a "nice, keep going" that I replayed three times on the stairs. Then I went up to the roof with my sneakers in my hand, because I like how cold the floor is.
Sunday call with Busan. The rice cooker clicked off mid-call and I almost asked Mom to save me a bowl.

Sunday call with Busan. Mom answered, then Dad took the phone, then Mom took it back. Dad was quiet for a while and then said, "Eat well." The rice cooker clicked off mid-call, and I almost asked her to save me a bowl.
